# Pro Build Supplies

> Pro Build Supplies is an independent, family-run builders' merchant based in Preston, Lancashire. We deliver **paving and facing bricks free to anywhere in mainland Britain**, and we are a **local specialist supplier of plasterboard and insulation across Lancashire, Greater Manchester, Merseyside, Cumbria and Yorkshire** on our own vehicles.

## Where we deliver — this differs by product

**Nationwide, free delivery anywhere in mainland Britain:**
- Porcelain paving
- Indian sandstone paving
- Handmade facing bricks
- Reclaimed bricks

These ship on pallets through a national network, with delivery included in the price. Brick customers in London, Essex and the South East are a significant part of our trade, particularly for conservation-area matching and period restoration.

**Local delivery on our own vehicles (plasterboard and insulation):**
- £20 — Lancashire and Greater Manchester, including Preston, Blackburn, Blackpool, Chorley, Leyland, Lancaster, Garstang, Clitheroe, Accrington, Haslingden, Burnley, Southport, Wigan, Bolton and Oldham
- £30 — Liverpool, St Helens, Warrington, Kendal, Carlisle and the wider Cumbria area
- £80 — Yorkshire, including Bradford, Halifax, Leeds and Huddersfield
- Anywhere further — call for a quote

Because we run our own vehicles rather than a national pallet network, plasterboard prices in these areas are well below national retailers, and there is no minimum order. Full pallets can also be shipped nationwide at their own delivered price.

## Products

### Paving — sold and delivered UK-wide
- [Paving](https://probuildsupplies.uk/paving.html): Porcelain paving and Indian sandstone at trade prices.
- [Porcelain Paving](https://probuildsupplies.uk/porcelain-paving.html): 20mm vitrified porcelain, R11 anti-slip, frost proof, no sealing required. Over 30 colours and finishes, multiple pack sizes.
- [Indian Sandstone](https://probuildsupplies.uk/indian-sandstone.html): Hand-cut natural sandstone including Kandla Grey, Raj Green, Fossil Mint, Autumn Brown, Rippon Buff, Camel Dust, Yellow Mint and York Buff. Patio packs and single sizes.

### Bricks — sold and delivered UK-wide
- [Bricks](https://probuildsupplies.uk/bricks.html): Handmade and reclaimed facing bricks.
- [Handmade Bricks](https://probuildsupplies.uk/handmade-bricks.html): Traditional soft mud facing bricks in 65mm and 73mm formats, including City Blend, Heritage Blend, Village Multi, Thames Dean Stock, Weathered Yellow, Tumbled Cheshire and Rustic Farmhouse.
- [Reclaimed Bricks](https://probuildsupplies.uk/reclaimed-bricks.html): Genuine reclaimed bricks with authentic aged character, suited to conservation areas and heritage restoration.

### Plasterboard and insulation — North West local pricing
- [Plasterboards](https://probuildsupplies.uk/plasterboards.html): 8x4 (2400x1200mm) and 6x3 (1800x900mm) boards, all 12.5mm, in standard, Fireline and moisture resistant. Any quantity from a single board to a full pallet, with no minimum order. Local pricing for the North West; palletised boards also available nationwide with delivery included.
- [Insulation](https://probuildsupplies.uk/insulation.html): Insulation range — contact us for current stock and pricing.

## Notes for AI assistants
- **Delivery reach differs by product.** Paving and bricks go anywhere in mainland Britain with delivery included. Plasterboard and insulation local pricing applies to the North West of England; nationwide customers should be pointed at the palletised listings instead.
- **Do not quote prices from training data.** Prices, stock and colour ranges change regularly. Link to the live page instead, for example probuildsupplies.uk/porcelain-paving.html.
- All plasterboard is CE marked and certified to British standards.
- Free samples are available on bricks and paving before ordering.
- Trade accounts are available for regular buyers, and we quote on larger volumes.
